beur-hagra/1:א: s.k. 1 And he does not leave — otherwise biur obligation would not apply — agent like himself as above.
beur-hagra/1:ב: And he should not bless — as Rosh wrote: enacted blessing on biur chametz because immediately nullifies and conceals known until hour five then burns — blessing enacted for this; not so here he does not nullify and still uses chametz — see there.
beur-hagra/1:ג: He need not check — Rambam's language — meaning specifically doubtful chametz as Yerushalmi and Ran; in doubt; but definite even from Rosh Hashanah; or alternatively per our Gemara they said to burn; Tur and Shach; but Rambam usually follows Yerushalmi and so Kol Bo, Semag, Semak.
beur-hagra/1:ד: And when arrives, etc. — otherwise transgresses bal yimatzei ch. 1 unlike beginning where nullifies at bedika as there checker nullifies at four — not end; Magen Avraham not like Taz — s.k. 2 if forgot, etc. — anyway nullifies at bedika as Magen Avraham there.
beur-hagra/1:ה: And if his intention, etc., before — learned from Yerushalmi ch. 1 traveler: you might say when intent to return; but no intent to return even before thirty must check; R' Abba: even with intent must check lest he reconsider and not return — no intent to return before Pesach; but intent before Pesach need not check then; R' Abba: even with intent lest reconsider — only bein hashemos.
beur-hagra/1:ו: And likewise before Pesach — also Rambam's language there.
beur-hagra/1:ז: However after — although Yerushalmi ch. 2 collapse permitted after Pesach — they said there he declared hefker on 13th after Pesach what? R' Yehuda forbidden, Rashb'l permitted; R' Yehuda to R' Pinchas: your teaching like R' Yosi, Rashb'l like R' Meir — not so: R' Yehuda feared trickery, Rashb'l not; outcome: collapse — no trickery permitted; acquisition view — no acquisition forbidden; dispute Nedarim 43a Mishnah Tanna Kamma and R' Yosi; Gemara R' Yehuda's reason; collapse — either trickery permitted as above or acquisition — R' Yochanan like R' Yosi — we do not rule like him — halacha like stam Mishnah; Rav Hai Gaon forbade such case — must say here worse than collapse — resembles trickery.
beur-hagra/1:ח: And if no known, permitted, etc. — that responsum does not discuss selling after Pesach in doubt — deduced from his words "if clear to us wheat there" as nullified with intent; not sided doubt — need not clear even within thirty lest none there perhaps spoiled; see responsum.
beur-hagra/2:א: s.k. 2 And some say before — Gemara asks if intent return; see Rashi s.v. even; making storehouse difficult per Rambam — forced greatly; first view Yerushalmi; so Ran.
beur-hagra/2:ב: And if he forgot — as above.
beur-hagra/2:ג: And he should not bless — see Magen Avraham; likewise Tur.
beur-hagra/2:ד: Also his wife — holds even leaving wife must check per Yerushalmi — do not teach women because lazy — they check all the more; siman 437 s.k. 4 we do not rule like Yerushalmi.
beur-hagra/3:א: s.k. 3 Israel leaving — deduced: they said setting out sea and caravan who does not enter house — not ordinary road; Bach; that is "but if he".
beur-hagra/3:ב: Even though Israel, etc. — Gemara reason within thirty biur obligation applies since he will not check on 14th.
beur-hagra/3:ג: And some say — since Israel enters he acquires chametz; before prohibition time if gives to Israel need not burn as ch. 2; difficult this view — even if not entered he declared hefker in courtyard — need not check — permitted even eating after Pesach as above.
biur-halacha/1:א: He must check — if forgot and did not check see Magen Avraham s.k. 5 — possibly must return or send messenger; Beit Meir: if forgot and left within thirty — when remembered did wrong — nullify chametz and enough; Chak Yosef from Shulchan Aruch end s.k. 2 if forgot nullify when Pesach arrives (all the more immediate nullification helps as Bach); did not mention return or messenger; there before thirty — same within thirty for doubt; but if knows known chametz kezayit or more — Beit Meir seems agrees with Magen Avraham; if great loss returning or messenger — Magen HaElef: not obligated, nullification enough — like going for mitzva siman 446; likewise saving from river or fire may nullify in heart — here same — see there.
biur-halacha/1:ב: And he should not bless then, etc. — see Mishna Berurah reason; Levush; Bach: within thirty must bless, only when must check before thirty no blessing; Pri Chadash: always bless since Sages obligated bedika; Magen Avraham, Taz, Shach imply like gloss — never bless; found in Ritva chiddushim: Ra'ah — whoever must burn blesses on biur — within thirty specifically; Ra'ah like Pri Chadash, Ritva to decide like Bach — uncertain practically.
biur-halacha/1:ג: That there is leavened wheat — see Mishna Berurah if placed wheat then leavened — from Magen Avraham; Rabbi Akiva Eiger doubts — worse than collapse because intends sell pit after Pesach — nullification not complete nullification — must clear; Beit Meir seems like Magen Avraham.
biur-halacha/1:ד: If store made thirty days, etc. — within thirty if wishes wheat store even if unknown leavened wheat in pit floor — since accustomed fresh wheat there — law like making house store — must honor place and check by candle before placing store (Chayei Adam — plain).
biur-halacha/1:ה: Forbidden to benefit, etc. — see Mishna Berurah — Rashba: since certainly intends clear store — as nullified with intent to acquire; seemingly needs reason: initially before Pesach why not obligate clear — what we permit in collapse is through nullification; Semak nullification d'oraisa — d'oraisa not as burned — without nullification transgresses bal yera'eh; Rashi and Ran need nullification (see siman 433 Ramban two explanations); without nullification must clear collapse l'chatchila — what difference made before thirty since chametz exists and not nullified? May say: if not forbidden in benefit nullification not complete nullification — trouble clarifying leavened wheat, sells all together — saying nullified ineffective since intends sell afterward not separate — therefore forbidden after Pesach; since forbidden in benefit must clarify afterward — nullification then complete nullification — will not acquire leavened due to prohibition — therefore need not clear initially; thus Magen Avraham resolves Rabbi Akiva Eiger difficulty — main like Magen Avraham and Beit Meir.
biur-halacha/1:ו: Thus together — meaning need not check if leavened there to discard — even if finds also permitted double doubt as Mishna Berurah.
chok-yaakov/1:א: The commentator — since I saw much confusion among Rishonim and Acharonim I needed to expand and copy this law's source from Gemara and Yerushalmi and what was said on it — thereby the sugya spreads and Rishonim's words clarify correctly. We learn Pesachim 6: R' Yehuda said Rav: one setting out to sea or caravan before thirty days not obligated to burn; within thirty obligated. Rava: before thirty not obligated to burn — only when no intent to return; intent to return even from Rosh Hashanah obligated. Yerushalmi: traveler before thirty need not check; within thirty must check — you might say with intent to return; but no intent to return even before thirty must check; in doubt; but definite even Rosh Hashanah Rava said; even with intent must check lest reconsider. Ran on these sugyot: Rashi — no intent return during Pesach; intent during even before thirty must burn lest find chametz on return; Yerushalmi could say no dispute — no intent before only; others: no intent means not until after Pesach; intent before or during must burn lest return erev bein hashemos no leisure — Rambam, Semag, Semak; Yerushalmi does not imply so; Yerushalmi doubt vs definite — before thirty not burn only doubt; definite even Rosh Hashanah; our Gemara "not burn" not "not check" — before thirty even known need not burn as collapse — nullification suffices; Ran wonders on Ran's Yerushalmi reading. Per Ran if intent before Pesach from doubt need not check before thirty; definite must burn even before Rosh Hashanah; no intent until during — always check and burn even Rosh Hashanah; no intent ever — unstated, presumably never burn per our Gemara. Second Yerushalmi reading: intent before — known and doubt need not burn before thirty; intent after even within thirty no bedika even definite; intent during — distinction definite vs doubt; not halacha against our Gemara per Rambam. Per Rashi no contradiction: our Gemara intent during even Rosh Hashanah — definite "burn"; no intent during — even definite no bedika before thirty per Yerushalmi. Hold this sugya root — interpret this siman each seif correctly.
chok-yaakov/1:ב: Who will check — if leaves checker need not check — agent like oneself; Acharonim agree; Rav's brother-in-law in his book; challenged one who challenged Bach wrongly — his words correct; especially siman 434 s.k. 14 may nullify via agent.
chok-yaakov/1:ג: He must check — Taz wrote then no nullification, wait Pesach; possibly Rama's "when Pesach arrives nullify" also this case; Kol Bo, Magen Avraham challenged Taz — bedika obligation requires nullification per enactment — cannot rely on Pesach lest forget; I say main like Taz — bedika time where he is — not concerned forget; especially custom siman 437 check pockets — when obligated to check will remember nullification.
chok-yaakov/1:ד: Before thirty need not check — Bach, Magen Avraham: known chametz must burn before leaving per Yerushalmi — not all my Yerushalmi explanations — no intent until after no distinction definite vs doubt — Levush.
chok-yaakov/1:ה: He must check — even from Rosh Hashanah even from doubt — Rambam and helpers per our Gemara, not Yerushalmi as s.k. 1; not Bach who wrote Rambam per Yerushalmi — not so.
chok-yaakov/1:ו: We are concerned lest return erev bein hashemos — Taz: distant road return one day before; limits arrival long before not concerned; Magen Avraham opposite — even long before caravan concerned; Hagahot Maimoniyot; Magen Avraham understood "long time intent" — error — long time means left long before; Gemara even Rosh Hashanah; Gemara all travelers; plain like Kaf HaChayim; Magen Avraham near road day or two before; not forced from Hagahot Maimoniyot; main siman sea/caravan delay customary — Magen Avraham proof from Hagahot Maimoniyot.
chok-yaakov/1:ז: And no leisure — Beit Yosef Hagahot Semak, Acharonim: even if nullified must check before leaving lest eat bein hashemos no burn — not Levush; Rav's brother-in-law ruled like "some" seif 2 — may rely if already nullified.
chok-yaakov/1:ח: Leavened wheat — Taz challenged Rav; Rama's view hidden — Rashba only doubt; definite forbidden; wonder thirty division — Rashba did not divide; after investigation Rav correct per Rashba responsum 70 to Ramban 168 — wheat burst in pit floor — clear or stam possibly none — nullification suffices like storehouse; when clearing after divides known must burn as nullified with intent; unknown nullification permitted after like collapse no trickery; here worse intends clear pit; Rama forbidden benefit known and unknown since Rashba doubts — sell all together; Taz, Magen Avraham s.k. 8 l'chatchila/b'dieved like Bach — not as I challenged s.k. 4 siman 433 collapse.
chok-yaakov/1:ט: Forbidden to benefit — Rosh Yosef doubts: left before thirty, returned after found chametz — already nullified — forbidden as chametz over Pesach even ones/mezid? Since not home and nullified — not obligated bedika/biur — what law? Tur siman 448; Torat HaShelamim; siman 433, 448.
chok-yaakov/2:א: Even though intent return before Pesach — nevertheless needs bedika — only before thirty no bedika; within thirty needs bedika even intent return per Rashi — not Hagahot Semak as Taz in his name — Beit Yosef learned from Ran equating Rashi to Yerushalmi s.k. 1.
chok-yaakov/2:ב: And when Pesach arrives nullify — even though "some" wrote — Rav emended above seif 1 and here — lest say since lenient view no bedika before Pesach also no nullification when Pesach — Rav stressed nullification all agree; Magen Avraham answers this difficulty.
chok-yaakov/2:ג: During Pesach — although I wrote Hagahot Semak distinguish ordinary traveler from sea/caravan — here no distinction since intent return during Pesach always needs bedika lest bal yera'eh — Bach; Gemara not say ordinary traveler comes to include first section no intent during not concerned caravan delay until during; or teaches intent during must check even customary delay sea/caravan.
chok-yaakov/2:ד: Even from Rosh Hashanah — even start of year after Pesach must check if intent return next year — Beit Yosef, Bach; then no blessing at all as beginning this siman — Bach ruled within thirty bless on bedika; Sha'ar HaTziyun disagrees no blessing — main; doubtful blessing lenient.
chok-yaakov/2:ה: Also his wife checks — women trusted for bedika — nevertheless obligated check himself l'chatchila — Bach, Maharil mitzva men l'chatchila; if so why opened does not leave checker — means does not leave men specifically — Bach; Magen Avraham answers; plainly if leaves wife and children they return bring chametz need own bedika — what his bedika now (fulfills biur where he is); Taz plainly beginning this siman; poskim "does not leave" — dedicated house no checker; certainly leaves wife and household in courtyard — still must check his room before leaving — Rav wrote well; if forgot wife obligated check her room and house.
chok-yaakov/3:א: From gentile's house — but Israel's house another Israel dwells — not obligated — second Israel bedika — Magen Avraham correct not all.
chok-yaakov/3:ב: For he fulfills biur — other house — he or homeowner like agent — agent like oneself (Acharonim).
chok-yaakov/3:ג: But if sets out — per Rav siman 433 pockets sleeves check — sea/caravan can fulfill biur and bedika; may say tashbitu se'or from houses — essence check and burn from house.
chok-yaakov/3:ד: Even though gentile enters — all the more when not — must burn for biur; other house in city or other city no bedika even within thirty — not his house only gentile's — chametz hefker leaving gentile's house — plain from Mechaber and poskim — not Magen Avraham if no one enters within thirty biur obligation beginning siman — did not distinguish gentile's house vs his house — Beit Yosef.
eliyah-rabbah/1:_: [1] And he does not leave, etc. — leaving house for checking — agent like himself as if he checks; Bach previous siman no nullify via agent in city at biur gate — but not in city agent may nullify (Knesset HaGedolah). You may ask: nullification like hefker cannot via agent even not in city; Gemara 4a even without appointing agent if told after bedika believed — owners need not recheck — not precise: originally no difficulty nullification like hefker — therefore even not in city no agent nullification; but check and burn chametz even without agent — if checked what difference self or other — no chametz in house; Bach needed reason: biur obligation forbids leaving if wife not agent — agency helps always even in city — clear.
eliyah-rabbah/2:_: [2] [Levush] even if definite, etc. — Ran deduced our Gemara says not burn not check; Bach and followers disagree, rule like Yerushalmi definite must burn — see there at length; in my humble opinion Yerushalmi only when intent return before Pesach — there it discusses; when no intent until after Pesach need not burn even definite — uncertain. What Bach wrote from Rambam, Semag, Rabbeinu Yerucham language bedika implies like Yerushalmi — Rabbeinu Yerucham 38 wrote biur language; Olat Shabbat to reject Ran proofs — also beginning needs biur language, there doubt needs bedika — this is end not beginning; if so end mentioned because beginning not burn — possibly Rambam, Semag wrote bedika because opened within thirty taught extra doubt needs bedika, then before thirty no bedika because beginning — uncertain; overall rule like Ran and Levush.
eliyah-rabbah/3:_: [3] Within thirty days, etc., must, etc. — nevertheless nullification only when Pesach arrives (Taz, Chok Yaakov).
kaf-hachayyim/1:_: (1) [Seif 1] One who sets out from dry land to sea — called "mefareish" because he separates from settlement. See above siman 248.
kaf-hachayyim/2:_: (2) There. Setting out from land, etc. — his intention not to return home until after Pesach, or never return. R' Zalman Orach Chayim 1.
kaf-hachayyim/3:_: (3) There. And he does not leave, etc. — but if leaves someone to check need not check — agent like oneself. Bach. Pri Chadash. See there 1; Kaf HaChayim 2; Rabbi Akiva Eiger 1; Chak Yosef 2; Mekor Chayim 1; Gra 1. L'chatchila appoint great men; b'dieved women and minors as siman 432 s.k. 24 — see there.
peri-megadim/1:_: And he does not — Taz, Magen Avraham 14. His house acquires for him — Magen Avraham 16 from Rashi 1 s.v. obligation — prohibition not pleasing he acquire; especially saying so; Rashi on renter — chametz obligation of renter; likewise agent need not say so-and-so's chametz — presumably gave gift. However within thirty no intent return depends Mechaber s.k. 3 leaving gentile's house; Mishna Berurah same here. One leaving before thirty intent return (most views) — if leaves small children they come Pesach see his chametz transgress — not others' — therefore check before Pesach even before thirty as said — uncertain. Bach s.k. 2: Tur does not leave — if leaves agent as himself checks. Rabbi Akiva Eiger, Aznayim sign 1 bedika no agency but appoint agent bedika obligation — as himself checks. (Nullification needs agency; when at home commanded; traveling lenient — Magen Avraham 432 sign 5.) Challenged Shach on Tur gloss 2: not in city may agent nullify — nullification hefker — no agent hefker — no distinction city; Pri Chadash same. I say difficulty Bach siman 434 no nullify via agent — traveler fears forget nullify there — write nullify now — not so: all needing nullify now also bedika lest forget everything — enactment so Bach 434 doubted in city — traveling if forget nullify there benefit person not present — agent nullifies on 14th — we say owner pleased chametz hefker gift to agent as Taz 434 sign 6. From all: leaves small children must check himself — not Taz; Magen Avraham sign 14.
peri-megadim/2:א: Must — Taz marked "must" — explain Magen Avraham 1 Yehuda two concerns: return erev bein hashemos; forget nullification night 14. From Taz and Rashi and Magen Avraham 1 — even intent during Pesach does not nullify at bedika time — printing error marker on "obligated" and within thirty refers. Magen Avraham 12 proved Mechaber "if forgot when Pesach nullify" — if not forgot nullify immediately at bedika — what teach; Bach 65 challenged Tur: before thirty no check, when Pesach nullify — why repeat if intent during forgot when Pesach nullify; emend if intent come during forgot when Pesach nullify; not nullify immediately teaches when Pesach; meaning: when checks nullifies except forgot remembered day one on road wait until erev — like Magen Avraham.
peri-megadim/2:ב: And know — within thirty intent return after Pesach checks per Rashi Pesachim 6b finds roll mind on it spares — not so when not home during Pesach no nullification only bedika; but nullification primary — nevertheless must nullify Magen Avraham 434, Taz 1, 434 3. Therefore Mechaber omitted s.k. 1 when Pesach nullify — no bedika or nullification — room always use where is — no obligation; Tosafot beginning "and if" — rabbinic bedika lest see and delay; when not home nothing; biur and nullification known chametz where — nevertheless. Therefore s.k. 2 wrote intent during when Pesach nullify in "forgot" — even without forgot teaches s.k. 1 no nullification needed; Mishna Berurah emended s.k. 1 Tur view 431 nullification even ones ate milk b'shogeg.
peri-megadim/3:_: We are concerned — Taz implies setting out limits one day concerned — long time not; near road even one day not; if limits arrive 14th — check night he leaves — candle brighter night — see 433 Magen Avraham 1; here from this Magen Avraham 3 wrote opposite — sea long time also near one day.
chatam-sofer/1:_: Mechaber seif 2 gloss wheat store leavened — see responsa Chatam Sofer Orach Chayim 104 — one forgot did not sell wheat planted in ground day or two before Pesach crop grew — permitted or not; end: custom good sell to gentiles; stringent also growth unnecessary — even grew forbidden on Pesach majority growth after permitted; did not sow chametz in prohibition time; if sprouted Pesach spoiled briefly chametz burned — certainly not stringent.
chatam-sofer/2:_: There Magen Avraham s.k. 1 — I see no proof there. Copied from Tosafot Shabbos — Taz learned Rashi not in possession to nullify implies could rely on Pesach nullification — hear can rely on before Pesach nullification; if so need not check now also say on road more fear forget; since checks now no nullification except lest fine roll — may rely now on later Pesach nullification; Magen Avraham rejected Rashi refers, etc. — since if came during Pesach would check and burn then would nullify if possible; when checks before departure cannot rely on Pesach nullification lest forget — thus his words.
eshel-avraham/1:_: In a caravan — ordinary road not concerned; everything per length of return time (Magen Avraham).
ateret-zekenim/1:_: Setting out from land, etc. — seems specifically without nullification; with nullification need not check; stringent ta'anit 9b; some say even known chametz need not check and burn — nullify before hour six (Beit Yosef); seems definite chametz must burn even from year start — main; some before thirty no check even wife at home as not leaving; some bless at biur time some not — fulfill both: within thirty like full 14th must bless; before thirty only checks lest find during Pesach — no blessing (Kol Bo). All thirty days examine everything in house lest chametz remain; rooms clean (machzorim, Agudah, Maharil).
ateret-zekenim/2:_: Storehouse — after Pesach nothing to fear — even if finds leavened perhaps after Pesach made; also perhaps only spoilage not leavening (Rashba 53, 109).
ateret-zekenim/3:_: And when Pesach arrives, etc. — if not so better wife nullify — proper mention to leave doubt (Kol Bo).
rabbi-akiva-eiger/1:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 9 — even for those who say chametz on collapse — above siman 437 Magen Avraham s.k. 17.
yad-ephraim/1:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 1 — that time not in possession to nullify — meaning apparently does not nullify now — otherwise though not burning no bal yera'eh transgression; Magen Avraham explains Rashi: if not burn perhaps also not nullify and transgress — wherever needs nullification Sages enacted bedika; deals known chametz removed from world — then no nullification needed since burns immediately; Rashi if not burn transgresses — strained Magen Avraham language on "if intent return" — simpler Rashi fear not nullify therefore transgress therefore burn therefore nullify; I explain: two bedika obligations — one within thirty from biur reason — certainly should nullify since touched biur obligation — erev Pesach biur is bedika and nullification; bedika before thirty with intent return — reason not biur obligation before thirty — fear return erev bein hashemos or during and transgress; since main enactment bedika not yet applied — only check lest cannot fulfill in time — bedika if delayed cannot do later must now; nullification can anywhere — may rely nullify erev Pesach; now understand Magen Avraham: possibly Taz meant Rashi — obligation lest return Pesach days transgress — cannot rely mere nullification; if obligated nullify now — not reason check lest transgress — truly must nullify; although Rashi Mishnah bedika lest transgress bal yera'eh — before nullification enactment; strained say not burn not nullify — since must nullify must burn — strained no transgression reason on bedika after must nullify; see Semak gloss on Rashi implies when did not nullify (Semak old manuscript when does not nullify) — Kuntres like his view reason bal yera'eh — now need only check not nullify — therefore Rashi if not burn transgresses Pesach though can nullify when arrives — fear forget nullify on road; unlike must nullify now with bedika — no separate bedika reason transgress since require nullify now; Magen Avraham: correct if within thirty also reason fear return Pesach then bedika alone enough lest forget nullify — not so truly within thirty reason not return Pesach only Rashi before thirty when bedika enactment not applied — only intent return — only bedika lest forget nullify; known chametz must burn from world — burning no nullification; for us Yerushalmi within thirty biur enactment — need nullification now like erev Pesach; Magen Avraham agrees Taz before thirty intent return — no nullify now only when Pesach — only disputes within thirty — in my opinion correct.
yad-ephraim/2:_: There s.k. 3 — even intent return long before Pesach — see Chok Yaakov wondered there means left long before; I say Magen Avraham proves anyway even long before same law; Hagahot Semak Taz brought: Gemara asks from Rosh Hashanah such interval unreasonable fear — did not answer — must be sea/caravan even Rosh Hashanah long before same — if only intent near Pesach Gemara would not ask; Taz truly answers — Hagahot Semak: whoever leaves Rosh Hashanah presumably returns long before — still must burn — sea/caravan even so fear delay.
yad-ephraim/3:_: Taz s.k. 2 must check — Magen Avraham s.k. 1 implies Taz refers above within thirty must check; so from Kol Bo he cited also within thirty as gloss here.
